name: Paula Gunn Allen
shortBio: Laguna Pueblo–Sioux philosopher and literary theorist whose The Sacred Hoop recovered gynocratic Indigenous cosmologies and non-hierarchical relational metaphysics.
centralQuestion: How do gynocratic Indigenous traditions challenge Western patriarchal binaries of spirit versus matter and human versus nature?

keyWorks.title: The Sacred Hoop: Recovering the Feminine in American Indian Traditions
keyWorks.description: Foundational text of Native American feminist philosophy exploring Pueblo gynocratic cosmology and sacred relationality.
